item.title: AGBO’s Russo Brothers Italian American Filmmaker Forum Launches 2026 Fellowship
item.description: The AGBO Foundation and the Italian Sons and Daughters of America (ISDA) proudly announce that applications will open on February 18, 2026, for the Russo Brothers Italian American Filmmaker Forum (RBIAFF) 2026 Fellowship.
